d: A figure of athletic build wearing a full-face tactical helmet with a narrow, glowing crimson visor that obscures the eyes and face. The attire is a futuristic combat uniform consisting of a light gray and white digital camouflage base layer, overlaid with heavy charcoal-black modular armor on the chest, shoulders, and hips, complemented by matching black knee pads and lace-up combat boots. The equipment includes a large black tactical rifle held in both hands and a small antenna protruding from the back of the helmet.
